_spec_only_history: Was spec_only:true in v1.1.5-v1.1.15 (orchestrator didn't honor --strict-on-hard-a51). Flipped to false in v1.1.16 (Sprint 1 / T6) when scripts/promote_strict_preflight.py landed — fixture now serves as a live regression baseline, not just a documented spec.
_authoring_mode_comment: Hand-authored spec-as-fixture for v1.1.5 (B3). From v1.1.16 onwards the orchestrator honors --strict-on-hard-a51 via scripts/promote_strict_preflight.py + hooks/pre_bash_promote.sh; this fixture is the canonical regression baseline for the BLOCKED message shape.
_model_fields_comment: model_used / model_version_hash will remain n/a — this fixture's whole point is to be a deterministic regression baseline for an opt-in failure-mode contract.
covers: spec for the proposed --strict-on-hard-a51 opt-in failure mode
canonical state with exactly one hard-blocking unresolved contradiction A51 row
expected BLOCKED message shape (stderr keywords + exit code)
does_not_cover: Soft / informational A51 rows — those NEVER block, even in strict mode (out of scope for this fixture; covered by tests/test_promote_strict_preflight.py::test_open_soft_row_does_not_block)
implementation_anchor: scripts/promote_strict_preflight.py + hooks/pre_bash_promote.sh strict-mode block (v1.1.16). See docs/strict_a51_mode.md for the operator-facing contract.
